propositions: Local code review preview command `rebar review-code` is underdocumented compared to the analogous local plan review preview (`rebar review-plan`), creating discoverability asymmetry for code-review authors.

The local code-review self-check must be surfaced in three canonical locations: the author on-ramp guide, the docs index, and the AGENTS.md pointer, to match how plan-review discoverability is handled.
The passing-code-review guide must document the `rebar review-code` preview step, including the `[agents]` extra and `REBAR_VERIFY_ENABLE_CODE_REVIEW` environment variable requirement.
The loop diagram in the passing-code-review guide must show `rebar review-code` as an optional local preview step to mirror the plan-review flow diagram.
